sources.title: LingBot‑VLA 2.0 Foundation Model - Robbyant
sources.snippet: It's showtime! LingBot‑VLA 2.0 can adapt to multiple robotic embodiments and, when combined with pretraining over whole‑body degrees of freedom, achieves more proficient and stable performance across a wide range of daily‑life tasks, including high‑precision, articulated‑object, and long‑horizon mobile manipulation.
